title: Inflammation, diabetic foot and related treatments.
one_liner_zh: 该文综述糖尿病足的炎症调控网络与治疗，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Diabetic foot, one of the most severe chronic complications of diabetes mellitus, arises from complex interactions among neuropathy, vascular ischemia, and inflammatory dysregulation. This review systematically explores the inflammatory regulatory network centered on NF-kappaB and the interleukin (IL) family in the diabetic foot microenvironment and examines their roles in promoting tissue damage. Under hyperglycemic conditions, the AGE-RAGE axis potently activates the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, leading to upregulation of pro-inflammatory factors and suppression of anti-inflammatory mediators, thereby forming a vicious cycle of "inflammation-oxidative stress-tissue damage." Charcot foot, a distinct subtype characterized by neurogenic osteoarthropathy, is strongly linked to abnormal IL-6/RANKL pathway activation and impaired anti-inflammatory neuropeptide signaling. We further assess the diagnostic utility of inflammatory biomarkers, including procalcitonin (PCT), high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP), and the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), and summarize current therapeutic challenges along with emerging targeted strategies, such as NF-kappaB inhibition via salicylates. This review underscores the importance of spatiotemporal heterogeneity and dynamic equilibrium within inflammatory networks for clinical stratification and proposes that integrating multi-omics data with artificial intelligence models holds promise for developing personalized interventions. This approach offers novel theoretical insights to overcome therapeutic bottlenecks in diabetic foot management.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病足是糖尿病最严重的慢性并发症之一，其发生源于神经病变、血管缺血及炎症调控失调之间的复杂相互作用。本综述系统探讨了以NF-kappaB和白细胞介素（IL）家族为核心的炎症调控网络在糖尿病足微环境中的作用，并分析其促进组织损伤的机制。在高血糖条件下，AGE-RAGE轴强效激活NF-kappaB信号通路，导致促炎因子上调及抗炎介质抑制，从而形成“炎症-氧化应激-组织损伤”的恶性循环。夏科足作为一种以神经性骨关节病为特征的独特亚型，与IL-6/RANKL通路异常激活及抗炎神经肽信号受损密切相关。我们进一步评估了炎症生物标志物的诊断价值，包括降钙素原（PCT）、高敏C反应蛋白（hs-CRP）及中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值（NLR），并总结了当前治疗挑战及新兴靶向策略，如水杨酸盐对NF-kappaB的抑制。本综述强调炎症网络中时空异质性和动态平衡对临床分层的重要性，并提出整合多组学数据与人工智能模型有望推动个性化干预的发展。该策略为克服糖尿病足治疗瓶颈提供了新的理论见解。
